# relay_backup_auto_export (Resource)

Copies the completed backups of a workspace's clusters to an S3 bucket through a cloud integration. There is one auto-export per workspace: two of these resources on the same workspace overwrite each other. Destroying the resource disables the export and leaves its settings stored, so the cloud integration it names cannot be deleted until the export is pointed at another one. An export disabled outside Terraform is removed from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "relay_cloud_integration" "backups" {
  workspace_id = relay_workspace.prod.id
  name         = "backups"
}

resource "relay_backup_auto_export" "prod" {
  workspace_id   = relay_workspace.prod.id
  integration_id = data.relay_cloud_integration.backups.id
  bucket         = "acme-relay-backups"
  prefix         = "prod/"
  which          = "scheduled"
  backfill       = true

  scope = {
    mode = "selected"
    ids  = [relay_postgresql_cluster.orders.id, relay_valkey_cluster.sessions.id]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) S3 bucket the backups are copied to.
- `integration_id` (String) Cloud integration in the same workspace whose role writes to the bucket, such as `data.relay_cloud_integration.this.id`.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace whose backups are exported.

### Optional

- `backfill` (Boolean) Also export the backups that already exist, oldest first, when the resource is created. Without it only backups completed from then on are exported. Sent on create only: changing it later plans an update that applies nothing, and an import sets it to false.
- `prefix` (String) Key prefix inside the bucket.
- `scope` (Attributes) Clusters whose backups are exported. Defaults to every cluster in the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scope))
- `which` (String) Backups to export: `all`, `scheduled` or `manual`. Defaults to `all`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workspace ID.
- `last_error` (String) Why the last export failed, when it did.
- `last_exported_at` (String) Time of the last successful export, RFC 3339, empty before the first one.

<a id="nestedatt--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scope`

Required:

- `mode` (String) `all` for every cluster in the workspace, including those created later, or `selected` for `ids`.

Optional:

- `ids` (Set of String) Cluster IDs, required when `mode` is `selected` and not allowed otherwise.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import relay_backup_auto_export.prod <workspace_id>
```
